result.title: KPI-Aware Multimodal Anomaly Detection for 5G and Open RAN Telemetry
result.comment: Accepted at the IEEE ICDM 2026 Applied Research Track
result.summary: Reliable anomaly detection is a deployment bottleneck for 5G/Open RAN observability and emerging self-optimizing 6G systems, where hundreds of heterogeneous KPIs, severe class imbalance, and strict alert budgets make purely numerical scores brittle. We present KAC, a deployment-oriented KPI-aware multimodal anomaly-detection framework that uses KPI-level residual-text alignment to turn compact operator-style summaries into a learnable feedback signal over full-KPI temporal evidence. This gives the detector broad numerical coverage like modern time-series models, while retaining the sparse KPI-specific reasoning that makes operator feedback sustainable in a future operator-facing workflow. Across public telecom telemetry, enterprise-scale Open RAN observability data, and a Nokia benchmark built from real 5G RAN production packet traces with realism-hardened injected anomalies, KAC achieves strong threshold-based detection performance while remaining competitive on threshold-free ranking metrics. On TelecomTS, at a fixed 2.5 percent false-positive-rate operating point, KAC achieves the highest recall among the evaluated residual-based methods while maintaining comparable precision; across the evaluated benchmarks, it remains robust under substantial class imbalance. KAC is integrated in pre-production shadow mode with Nokia's GKE-based KPI construction pipeline, where it continuously scores telemetry windows alongside an internal packet-level anomaly detector for operational evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 面向 5G/Open RAN 运维遥测的 KPI 感知多模态异常检测框架，用 KPI 级残差-文本对齐把运维摘要转为对全 KPI 时序证据的可学习反馈信号，并在多个电信数据集上评估检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是电信 KPI 时序异常检测，不涉及视觉细节、实体关系或推理状态的生成与使用；其中的「告警预算」仅是部署阶段的运行点约束，而非推理中的证据获取或停止决策，故缺少与 LVR 主线的实质联系。
